label: MQTT -> Loki Logger
info:
Subscribes to # on the local broker, drops homeassistant/# and $SYS/# discovery/system noise plus any pattern from the app's 'Filter patterns' option, derives labels (device/type/topic/format) from the topic and payload, and ships every remaining message verbatim to Loki. Also flushes rolling stats to Loki every 60s (source=mqtt-logger,type=stats) and routes any push failure or thrown error to an error stream (source=mqtt-logger,type=error) so both are queryable/graphable in Grafana.

MQTT credentials and the filter pattern list come from the app's own configuration options (Settings -> Add-ons/Apps -> MQTT Logger -> Configuration) - nothing to edit here. LOKI_URL stays fixed at the in-container Loki instance.

In Grafana, explore logs with {source="mqtt"}, filter by device/type/topic/format, or {source="mqtt-logger",type="stats"} / type="error" for the operational streams.
